name: Romantasy
hint: The romance's phases braided with a fantasy plot: the world makes the obstacles, and love decides the battle. Each step can become several chapters.

parts.title: Two worlds
chapters: The first world
The main character, the burden and the lie they live by. Give the reader a reason to root for them, and show the price of magic here, so the reader trusts the rules later.
The meeting
The two meet as their goals collide. The spark must be both resistance and pull, and each needs a reason not to trust the other.
The second voice

The love interest's world: the secret, the loyalty and why they cannot let the main character go. In dual POV, this is their first chapter. With a single POV, show it through what the main character sees but does not understand.
The bargain
A quest, a pact or a magical bond ties them together so neither can walk away. The book's first turning point, about a quarter of the way in.

parts.title: Drawn closer
chapters: New rules
The world opens up: the court, the borderlands, the danger. They must work together, and start to respect what the other can do.
The magic wakes
A power or a heritage shows itself and costs something. The other sees it first, and it becomes a bond or a threat between them.
Almost
A moment of closeness cut short by the world or turned down by one of them. The reader should ache, and the choice should show.
The midpoint
The first kiss or night, as a truth about the world turns the plot and changes what they are fighting for.

parts.title: Betrayal and choice
chapters: The false calm
They are close and it seems to hold, while the secret and the enemy draw near. Plant what is about to fall.
The betrayal
The secret comes out when the stakes are highest. It must feel inevitable and come from someone's wound, not a misunderstanding.
Apart
The enemy gains ground and the two stand on opposite sides. Each, alone, sees what they have lost. The low point, for love and for the world at once.
The choice
Both see through their lie, and the main character chooses. Love and what is right become the same choice, and it truly costs.

parts.title: What remains
chapters: The battle
The arcs meet: the grand gesture is part of the deciding battle, and the magic takes its price.
The bond
Love is spoken and shown. Both have changed, and the other sees it. Whoever betrayed has made amends in deeds, not just in an apology.
The new realm
Happily ever after, or happy for now with a promise that holds until the next book, in a world changed by what they did. Let the final image echo the first.
